name: @natlang/compilers
description: Optimizing compilers for C, typed Python and Rust written in natural language: front ends, an LLVM-IR middle end and an AArch64 back end, every stage checked by running the program.

compilers.description: natlang run applications/compilers -- compile PROGRAM.c|.py|.rs [-O2] [--input FILE]... | bench [NAME...]
